description: This is a PHP source file implementing API endpoints for sale vouchers in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a Voucher controller class with methods to add, apply, and remove vouchers, handling JSON input/output and interacting with the model and session.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class managing voucher-related API endpoints such as add, apply, and remove voucher operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of applying a voucher, validating input, and setting session data or errors accordingly.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates and adds a new voucher with details provided via POST data, performs validation, and updates session vouchers list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a voucher identified by key from the session vouchers list
